environment.description: Lambda function deployed into VPC subnet sg-0a1b2c3d4e (subnet-priv-0x8f2a) associated with route table rtb-0f3e2d1c that contains only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for DynamoDB (pl-02cd2c6b -> vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f). No NAT gateway, no internet gateway route, no other VPC endpoints. Security group egress rules allow only port 443 to prefix list pl-02cd2c6b (DynamoDB gateway endpoint CIDR). DNS resolution returns NXDOMAIN for all non-AWS hostnames due to Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint with forwarding rule that only resolves *.amazonaws.com via the VPC+2 resolver.

config.subnet: subnet-priv-0x8f2a (no route to igw or nat)
config.dns_config: Route53 Resolver forwarding rule: *.amazonaws.com -> VPC+2 resolver, all other -> REFUSED
